rows.traditional: A 同 B 呈線性關係
rows.jyutping: A tung4 B cing4 sin3 sing3 gwaan1 hai6
rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when saying that two quantities are related by a linear function.
Use this when linearly modifies an action such as increasing, decreasing, or changing.

example.english: After the temperature rises, the electricity bill increases linearly.
example.traditional: 氣溫升高之後，電費會線性咁增加。
example.jyutping: hei3 wan1 sing1 gou1 zi1 hau6 din6 fai3 wui6 sin3 sing3 gam3 zang1 gaa1

rows.traditional: A 同 B 成正比
rows.jyutping: A tung4 B sing4 zing3 bei2
rows.note: Use this for the narrower case where one quantity is directly proportional to the other, with no additive constant.

example.english: In this lamp, power consumption and brightness are linearly proportional.
example.traditional: 喺呢盞燈入面，耗電量同光度成正比。
example.jyutping: hai2 ni1 zaan2 dang1 jap6 min6 hou3 din6 loeng6 tung4 gwong1 dou6 sing4 zing3 bei2
